target_claim: A transparent weekly rule improves a documented judge-quality/fan-influence/stability trade-off across plausible vote distributions.

leakage_risks: normative weights must not be fit to final placement
data_audit.missingness_notes: Only weeks supported by current Q1 evidence enter the rule grid.

baseline.name: 50/50 percentage rule
baseline.reason: transparent current-style reference and exact official formula family
baseline.validation: historical replay over Q1 uncertainty and controversy cases

candidates.name: robust weighted-percent rule with bottom-two safeguard
candidates.formulation: Choose judge weight a on a fixed grid to minimize worst-case normalized judge-discordance, fan-disfranchisement, and rule-instability loss over Q1 vote draws; judges save the technically stronger of the bottom two.
assumptions: three published criteria represent the recommendation goal
weight preferences are reported as sensitivity ranges
judge save uses observed score only
refutation_evidence: selected weight changes by more than 0.20 across reasonable criterion weights
more than 25% of draws reverse recommendation
candidates.decision_reason: Produces an explicit transparent rule and makes normative sensitivity visible rather than learning an unavailable engagement target.

candidates.name: trimmed rank aggregation
candidates.formulation: Add judge and fan ranks after capping either side's maximum rank contribution, then apply a bottom-two safeguard.
assumptions: rank robustness is preferable to cardinal differences
candidates.decision_reason: Simple, communicable alternative if weighted-percent recommendation is fragile.

candidates.name: engagement-optimized learned rule
candidates.formulation: Fit a policy to maximize viewer engagement and retention.
parameter_sources: no engagement fields in official data
rejection_evidence: official 53-column file contains no audience or engagement field
candidates.decision_reason: The requested dataset contains no engagement target, so the objective is not identifiable.

primary_model: robust weighted-percent rule with bottom-two safeguard
stop_conditions: recommendation reverses in more than 25% of plausible vote draws
